newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan people cool, or indifferent, on HK handover.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan people cool, or indifferent, on HK handover.

text.p: Taiwan people on Monday voiced a mixture of apathy, caution and mild excitement when asked about Hong Kong's handover to communist China, Taiwan's arch rival since a 1949 civil war split.
A sampling of views from ordinary people in the streets of the capital Taipei:
"I don't see any reason to celebrate, but it (the handover) was inevitable." -- Oeu Su-i, 17, student.
"It's normal because Hong Kong is a part of China and doesn't really affect us because we are in Taiwan." -- Chen Chia-yi, 22, bakery worker.
"It's the natural thing. But this is not the right time for Taiwan to go back (to China)." -- David Ku, 52, senior engineer.
"I'm very happy about Hong Kong going back." -- Cai Yao-wen, 23, university student.
"It's good that Hong Kong is going back but it would be better if China were a democracy. Until then, Taiwan shouldn't go back (to China)." -- Paul Lu, 40, engineer.
"I don't have any feelings about it but it's right for Hong Kong to go back." -- Cai Jin-tang, 63, taxi driver.
"The people over there (in Hong Kong) will go through a great change. The people will go poor." -- Peter, 19, salesman.
"People with lots of money should be worried. I think China won't attack us because Taiwan is a part of China." -- Hwang Chin-shien, 45, security guard.
"China thinks Hong Kong is theirs, and therefore England should return it. As for the rest (of what happens), it is up to China. We can't do anything about it." -- Lin Su-miao, 48, housewife.
"Concerning political issues, only the future will tell. Just hope that it's good and that Taiwan might follow in the same steps." -- Lin Su-yin, 50, housewife, sister of Lin Su-miao.
"Basically it's bad (for Hong Kong) because it's a high going to a low, meaning a democracy going to communist rule," Carol, 17, student.
"I think it's bad that Hong Kong is going back. The territory (of China) will expand and that is dangerous for us." -- Jenny, 33, fashion designer.
